timestampMeaning: Agent decision time, not a user-message receipt timestamp
authorityBasis: The project owner delegated necessary release-readiness decisions and continued execution to the agent. This decision selects an independently stored private backup for the successor release, subject to reviewed implementation and measured verification.
reason: The available secondary local medium cannot presently satisfy reliable release custody. Use a verified existing private cloud backup, preserving earlier custody records and all existing backup data.
primaryStorage: Verified local owner custody outside the source checkout
verificationRequirements: Independently review and test the explicit local-plus-cloud custody path before execution; preserve historical two-volume acceptance.
Bind execution to this exact approval, build number, bucket and unique prefix under the approved root.
Read back existing privacy, versioning and retention controls before uploading; fail if they differ or permit public access.

Upload only independently verified governed release packages, their checksum sidecars and privacy-safe finalization/custody records; do not upload credentials, signing material, device screenshots or business payloads.
Use create-only uploads, record exact object generations and sizes, then download each exact generation and compare SHA-256 and byte length against its verified local source.
Verify the production package in local and private cloud custody before creating the built tag; verify closure and custody records afterward before finalization succeeds.
Record local-plus-cloud independence truthfully; never describe cloud storage as a second local volume or reuse an old release's custody evidence.
notAuthorizedByThisDecision: Public download, pilot handout or tester invitations
Bucket creation, IAM or ACL changes, retention or lifecycle changes
Deletion or replacement of any existing cloud or local backup
Business-data access, mutation, export or import
Reuse of a consumed build number or a claim that an artifact already exists
